authorization: User approved implementation of native-agent cancellation decisions, scoped tools and retained explicit direct cancellation.
supersedes: Original C07 deterministic conversational recognizer and its stalled-agent chat shortcut.
current_decision: | C07 | Stop pekerjaan dan arahan tambahan | Pengguna menyampaikan pembatalan melalui percakapan/steer. Agent menafsirkan konteks dan memilih structured tool cancel_run atau control_goal/control_routine; backend memvalidasi scope, target, receipt dan native confirmation. Endpoint cancel langsung tetap tersedia ketika harness macet. | Inti | Wajib. Keputusan <date start="2026-10-31" />: hapus cancellation-intent regex/deterministic language classifier. Agent memutuskan dari konteks melalui tools; steer mengirim arahan saat runtime mendukung dan tidak menjamin pemrosesan instan. Chat biasa tetap antre; endpoint cancel eksplisit independen dari model/antrean. Stop run berbeda dari pause/stop goal/Routine. Tombol Stop khusus tetap opsional. | O3, O8 |
